issue.title: Document Expo local dev auth troubleshooting
issue.body:
## Summary

Document that local development requires **no Expo account**, and how to fix dev-client launch failures caused by a mismatched global Expo CLI session.

## Background

Contributors logged into an Expo account without access to this EAS project can hit `UnexpectedServerData` / code-signing errors on launch. The CLI signs dev manifests with user credentials when online; `npx expo logout` or `expo start --offline` fixes it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] README troubleshooting explains local dev needs no Expo login
- [ ] Documents `npx expo whoami`, `npx expo logout`, and `expo start --offline`
- [ ] Notes session is global to the machine (persists across clones), not in the repo
- [ ] Clarifies Expo/EAS login is only for maintainer tasks (`eas build`, `eas update`, `eas submit`)

## Verification

Follow README steps on a machine logged into a foreign Expo account; confirm logout resolves launch errors.
